title: Jinja

run.description: Use a Jinja template with a context to create a file

template.description: The template to apply the values to. Either a file or string.

string.description: A string which is used as the jinja template

context.description: A dictionary used to define the output template

output_file.description: File name/path for the file to be output

description: Use a Jinja template with a context to create a file
guidance:
Use a Jinja template with a context to create a file.

### Run
### Recipe
```yaml
run:
  on_start:
    - jinja:
        template:
          string: >-
            {% if Brand is defined %} {{ Brand }} {% endif %} {% if ProductType is defined %} {{
            ProductType }}, {% endif %}
        context:
          Brand: Brand
          ProductType: Product Type
        output_file: my_template.jinja
```

### Function
```python
from wrangles.connectors import ckan

template_string = '{% if Brand is defined %} {{ Brand }} {% endif %} {% if ProductType is defined %} {{ ProductType }}, {% endif %}'

df = jinja.run(
    template={'string': template_string},
    context={'Brand': 'Brand', 'ProductType': 'Product Type'},
    output_file='my_template.jinja'
)
```
